summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a three-member MariaDB Galera cluster (MariaDB 10.1.48 + galera-3 from the official MariaDB xenial repo, since Ubuntu's native mariadb-server-10.0 build for this i386/Xenial image lacked wsrep support). Verified multi-master write propagation, availability with one node down (quorum preserved), and automatic resync (IST) when the node returns. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on all three nodes with boot-identity proof and full cluster recovery after each.
actions_performed: Fixed apt sources on all nodes: archive.ubuntu.com/security.ubuntu.com were unreachable in this environment; repointed sources.list to mirrors.mit.edu
Discovered Ubuntu Xenial's native mariadb-server-10.0 (i386) is compiled without WSREP/Galera support; purged it
Added MariaDB official repo (archive.mariadb.org/mariadb-10.1, i386 xenial) and installed mariadb-server-10.1 + galera-3 (with wsrep support) on all three nodes

Wrote /etc/mysql/mariadb.conf.d/60-galera.cnf on each node with wsrep_provider, wsrep_cluster_address (gcomm://10.100.66.10,.11,.12), wsrep_sst_method=rsync, unique wsrep_node_address/name, plugin-load-add=auth_socket.so
Bootstrapped the cluster on node1 via galera_new_cluster, joined node2 and node3 via systemctl start mariadb (rsync SST)
Generated a MariaDB root password on node1 (via openssl rand on-node) and set root to mysql_native_password; verified it replicated to node2/node3 via SST
Verified multi-master replication: inserted distinct rows from node1, node2, node3 and confirmed all rows visible from every node

Disruption test: stopped mariadb on node3, confirmed node1/node2 remained Primary (cluster_size=2) and writable, then restarted node3 and confirmed automatic IST resync back to size=3 Synced with all data present
Enabled mariadb service for boot persistence on all nodes

Mandatory restart protocol: captured boot_id + cluster health baseline on all 3 nodes, rebooted node1, node2, then node3 one at a time (preserving 2-node quorum each time), polled each until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and confirmed cluster_size=3/Synced/Primary plus intact table data after each restart

evidence.requirement: MariaDB Galera cluster of 3 members formed and healthy
evidence.summary: node1 shows wsrep_cluster_size=3, wsrep_ready=ON, wsrep_cluster_status=Primary, wsrep_incoming_addresses lists all 3 node IPs

evidence.requirement: Writes through any member available from the other members
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 visible on node2; row inserted on node2 visible on node3; row inserted on node3 visible back on node1 (full mesh replication)

evidence.requirement: Database stays available when one member is down
evidence.summary: node3 stopped; node1 still Primary with cluster_size=2 and accepted a new write; node2 confirms the write replicated
node3 restarted, log shows WSREP IST 'Receiving IST' seqnos 5-6 from node2 and 'Synchronized with group'; node3 query shows cluster_size=3, Synced, and the row written while it was down

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node1 baseline / restart ack / changed boot id / recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id f41e1f8a.../cluster healthy; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id f9d41d4c... confirms restart; post-restart cluster_size=3 Synced Primary with data intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node2 baseline / restart ack / changed boot id / recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id e881ab3c...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id 546106cb... confirms restart; post-restart cluster_size=3 Synced Primary with data intact

evidence.requirement: Node restart evidence: node3 baseline / restart ack / changed boot id / recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 847a859d...; reboot acknowledged; new boot_id c305ec07... confirms restart; post-restart cluster_size=3 Synced Primary with data intact

evidence.requirement: Final cluster-wide health check after all restarts
evidence.summary: node1 reports wsrep_cluster_size=3 and wsrep_incoming_addresses listing all three node IPs, confirming full quorum restored after sequential restarts
